comment: Trimmed from Playwright 1.57.0's own browsers.json to the single browser this repo runs. Keeping the other nine would make @playwright//... expand to every browser for every platform — about 7 GB of archives — so the mistake is removed rather than documented. What went with them, should anyone need it back: 'ffmpeg', which Playwright's record_video_dir requires, and full 'chromium', which a headed or trace run wants — re-add the entry verbatim from the wheel's playwright/driver/package/browsers.json rather than writing one, since 'revision' is what selects the download. Must stay in step with the playwright pin in requirements_lock.txt; //:test_spa_prefetch compares both the filename and every entry against that same file.
